event: A creak sound comes up, and the robot is standing by the light-gray three-seater couch and facing the wooden china cabinet. Determine the relative direction of the sounding object.

sounding_object.description: The sounding object is the front door. It is a light blue, arched wooden door with a black metal cross-shaped window frame in its upper half. A floral wreath with pink and white flowers, green leaves, and some decorative eggs is hung on the window. It has a black door handle and is set within a stone archway, which is trimmed in white and decorated with a string of small white lights.

reference_object.description: A light gray fabric upholstered three-seater couch with three removable seat cushions and three removable back cushions. It features rolled arms and is adorned with several throw pillows, including a yellow one and a white textured one. Its feet are dark and short.

facing_object.description: A tall, traditional-style wooden china cabinet, likely made of oak or a similar medium-brown wood. The upper section has glass-paneled doors, through which white china (plates, cups) is visible, arranged on shelves. The lower section consists of wooden cabinets or drawers. It is positioned against a wall, likely in a dining or living area.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray three-seater couch and facing the wooden china cabinet, when the creak sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
